NON-DISCLOSURE AGREEMENT
This Non-Disclosure Agreement (“Agreement”) has been made by and between Netaş Telekomünikasyon A.Ş. (hereinafter referred to as “NETAŞ”) having its principle place of business at  Istanbul/Turkey
and                     (hereinafter referred to as “Company”) having its principle place of business at                                 .
NETAS and Company shall also be referred to individually as “Party” and collectively as “Parties”.
The purpose of this Agreement is to protect confidential information of the Parties related to their business and products shared with the frame of a potential business relationship between the Parties.
NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual rights and obligations herein set forth, the Parties agree as follows:
DEFINITIONS
“Confidential Information” means any of the Disclosing Party’s information relating to (i) the Disclosing Party’s technology and products used and/or owned by the Disclosing Party, including without limitation, technical data, trade secrets, know-how, research, product plans, ideas or concepts, products, services, software, inventions, patent applications, techniques, processes, developments, algorithms, formulas, technology, designs, schematics, drawings, engineering, and hardware configuration information (collectively, “Technical Information”), and/or (ii) the Disclosing Party’s operations and business or financial plans or strategies, including but not limited to customers, customer lists, markets, financial statements and projections, product pricing and marketing, financial or other strategic business, plans or information and environmental circumstances such as meetings of the Parties  (collectively, “Business Information”), disclosed to the Recipient Party by the Disclosing Party either directly or indirectly, in writing, orally or by drawings or inspection of samples, equipment or facilities.
"Disclosing Party" means the Party who discloses the Confidential Information.
"Recipient Party" means the Party who receives the Confidential Information.
TERM
This Agreement shall be in force from the date of signature by both Parties and as long as the cooperation between the Parties will continue but at least for a period of 2 (two) years.
Notwithstanding termination of the Agreement for whatever reason any obligation with respect to Confidential Information placed upon the Recipient Party in the Agreement shall remain in force for a period of 5 (five) years after the date such Confidential Information is disclosed to the Recipient Party.
LIMITATIONS
Subject to the provisions in this Agreement, Confidential Information will not be used or disclosed in whole or in part without the prior written consent of the Disclosing Party.
The Recipient Party shall only use Confidential Information it has obtained within the scope of the Agreement and shall only reproduce such information at the time and to the extent required for the business relationship or transaction. The Recipient Party shall give such information only to such employees who need to know for the performance of the business or transaction and the employees of such companies involved in the business, as affiliates and subsidiaries, agencies and sub-labor to the extent required for the performance of the subject of the business or transaction and the people to whom Confidential Information have been given shall be informed on the confidentiality obligation stated within the scope of the Agreement.
Without the prior written consent of the Disclosing Party, the Recipient Party shall not use the name of the Disclosing Party in any advertisement, press release, press campaign or any other statements.
STANDARD OF CARE
The Recipient Party agrees to:
treat all the Confidential Information as secret and confidential and safeguard it with the same level of care it applies to the its own information;
inform each person to whom it discloses Confidential Information of the confidential nature of the information;
inform the Disclosing Party as soon as it becomes aware of any breach or impending breach of this Agreement; and
not remove any Confidential Information stamps, if it is marked as “confidential”.
EXCLUSIONS
This Agreement imposes no obligation upon Recipient with respect to Confidential Information which;
was known to Recipient before receipt from Disclosing Party as shown by written documentation;
is or becomes publicly available through no fault of Recipient Party;
is rightfully received by Recipient Party from a third party without a duty of confidentiality;
is disclosed by Recipient Party with Disclosing Party's prior written approval.
is independently developed by Recipient Party without reference to Confidential Information received hereunder; or
Recipient Party may disclose Confidential Information where it is ordered by a court of competent jurisdiction to be produced by Recipient Party, provided, however, that, upon receipt of any such order, Recipient Party shall immediately notify Disclosing Party so that an appropriate protective order may be sought.
RESPONSIBILITY
The Recipient Party will be responsible for any breach of confidentiality or any misuse of the Confidential Information by any party or person related to the Recipient Party, or any other party or person to whom the Recipient Party discloses the Confidential Information, including employees, consultants and advisors.
Disclosing Party warrants that it has the right to disclose its Confidential Information. The parties expressly recognize that confidential information is provided "as is".  Disclosing Party makes no warranties expressly or impliedly about accuracy of the shared confidential information.
DISCLAIMER
This Agreement imposes no obligation on either party to exchange Confidential Information or to purchase or sell any goods or services or enter into any transaction whatsoever and Neither party has made any commitment to the other regarding disclosing any of its Confidential Information or entering into a future business relationship, and each party will bear its own costs and expenses in connection with this Agreement whether or not such a relationship is consummated.
Nothing in this Agreement shall be construed to grant, expressly or by implication, any license or right to Recipient Party to make, use or sell, or otherwise commercialize the Confidential Information disclosed by Disclosing Party or any intellectual property or intellectual property rights of Disclosing Party.
INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY
Confidential Information will remain the property of the Disclosing Party. No license or right is granted by either party to the other to any intellectual propriety right, including, but not limited to, any patent, patent application, trademark, copyright, or any application therefore.
Nothing contained in this Agreement shall preclude either party from entering into similar agreements with others, or from disclosing to others information that is similar or identical to information disclosed to the other party under this Agreement, or from developing or having developed products or technology that are similar to or compete with products or technology of the other party, provided the receiving party does not violate its obligations hereunder in connection therewith.
PROTECTION OF PERSONAL DATA
Related with the services to be rendered under this Contract, the Recipient Party agrees, declares and undertakes that, in the event the Disclosing Party shares the Personal Data concerning itself and the customers or employees of the Disclosing Party (including special personal data), it shall process such Personal Data as required in conformity with the procedures and principles set out in the scope of the legislation concerning Personal Data Protection Law Nr: 6698 (Personal Data Legislation) and solely as required for the performance of obligations under this Contract and keep such data confidential and not use them other than intended purpose and to destroy such Personal Data in the event of expiry or termination  of services, for any reason whatsoever, under this Contract. The Recipient Party may maintain the Personal Data as required in the scope of its legal requirements.
In the event Personal Data are acquired by others through illegal means, the Recipient Party agrees and declares to immediately notify the circumstances to the Disclosing Party. In the event requested by the Disclosing Party, the Recipient Party shall assist the Disclosing Party to take any action it deems suitable to deal with any complaints or claims including immediate submission to the Disclosing Party of any disclosure of and permission to process any Personal Data in the scope of art. 3 which it retains in connection with the data owner.
The Recipient Party agrees, declares and undertakes to take any technical and administrative safety action legally mandatory with an aim to ensure safety of personal data and to comply with the requests to “ensure the safety of the data” under collective liability, received personally from the other party within a reasonable period of time.
The Parties shall be obligated to comply with all the applicable regulations, procedures and principles concerning the protection of personal data, in particular the relevant Law, Personal Data Legislations and decisions of Personal Data Protection Board.
REMEDIES
The Recipient Party shall indemnify and hold harmless the Disclosing Party, its employees, directors and officers against and from all claims, damages, losses and expenses (including legal fees and expenses) arising out of or in connection with any breach of this Agreement by the Recipient Party.
Each Party acknowledges that damages for improper disclosure of Confidential Information may be irreparable; therefore, the injured Party is entitled to seek equitable relief, including injunction and preliminary injunction, in addition to all other remedies available at law or in equity for a breach hereof.
Each Party shall be responsible for any breaches of this Agreement by any of its employees, consultants, independent contractors or agents (or those of its subsidiaries and affiliates).
APPLICABLE LAW
The Agreement shall be governed by and construed exclusively in accordance with Turkish Law without regard to its conflict of laws principles.
Any disputes or claim arising out of or in connection with this Agreement or the breach, termination or invalidity thereof shall be settled by in Istanbul Courts and Execution Offices.
MISCELLANEOUS
This Agreement contains the entire understanding between the Parties, superseding all prior communications, agreement and understandings between the Parties with respect to the purpose of this Agreement. Amendments to the agreement may only be made in writing.
At a Disclosing Party’s request, the Recipient Party will return or destroy all Confidential Information of the Disclosing Party, including all copies and all documents and computer files containing summaries, analyses or conclusions derived from such Confidential Information. No change, modification, alteration or additional to any provision of this Agreement shall be binding unless in writing and signed by an authorized of each Party.
No delay or failure to take any action hereunder will constitute a waiver unless expressly waived in writing, signed by the Party charged with such waiver, and no single waiver will constitute a continuing or subsequent waiver.
If the enforcement or operation of any provision of this Agreement is prohibited by law or if any provision of this Agreement or part thereof is by law rendered void, invalid or unenforceable, such prohibition, voidness, invalidity or unenforceability shall not affect the validity or enforceability of any other provision or condition of this Agreement. If this procedure is not possible, the Parties shall, acting reasonably, attempt to agree on valid provisions with similar effect, which will replace the invalid provision.
This Agreement shall not be assignable or transferable without the prior written consent of the other Party.
The addresses written in the agreement are the legal addresses of the Parties. All notices, sent to these addresses via registered mail or Public Notary will be deemed as received. Parties will notify each other in writing in case of an address change.
IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the Parties signed this Agreement in duplicate to one sole and with one appendix, effect on                        , each keeping one copy of the same.
